_comment: Curated model catalog for the Canopus 'On this device' tier (Ollama). Every entry MUST support native OpenAI tool calling; the agent loop cannot drive the rig without it (this is why DeepSeek-R1 and Gemma 3 are excluded; Gemma 4 added tool calling). min_vram_gb is the rough floor to run mostly on the GPU (0 = fine on CPU / low VRAM). size_gb is the download size (Q4-class). Ranked small -> large; the host recommends the largest whose min_vram_gb fits the detected/declared VRAM. Keep tags valid Ollama tags.

models.note: Smallest QAT model, runs on CPU or a small GPU. Last-resort quality.
QAT effective-4B; a good low-VRAM pick.
Small, strong tool-caller; a solid default on 6-8 GB.
Best quality/size ratio; validated end-to-end with Canopus.
Larger reasoning model; needs ~14 GB with context.
High quality; wants ~18 GB or it starts spilling.
Top quality; needs ~22 GB and spills to CPU (slow) on a 16 GB card.
